Neither the leaf inventory nor the vocabulary is expressible in, or derivable from, cached wiki text or a physics/math formula.

verdict_basis: Weak/structural, not a recomputation. The leaf is snapshot metadata whose contents no cached wiki text or quoted formula can determine, so 'both_wrong' and 'old_value_correct' would each require an assertion the evidence does not support (that the map is wrong, or that the snapshot must not carry per-leaf provenance). The new value is admissible: it moves no wiki-derived number, contradicts nothing in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md, and matches the documented disclose-rather-than-bare-number posture of Section 4.
caveats: This leaf is NOT independently computable from the R-18/R-19 evidence tree. The verdict certifies non-contradiction and admissibility, not entry-by-entry correctness of the dispositions map.

Entry-level correctness (does each leaf path get the right disposition and view_tag?) requires reading the engine's classification code, which this runbook forbids. It should be discharged by a different check (unit tests over the classifier), not by an oracle.
